$$人類の終末（ハルマゲドン）$$
Unless the seven $$封印$$s on Heaven's throne are opened, the $$世界$$ will remain in its evil state.
But when the $$神の子羊$$ opens the $$封印$$s one by one, calamities, death, and conflict spread across the $$世界$$...
At last, God gives seven angels seven trumpets.
Then the restraint that had held back the $$世界$$'s collapse is removed, and the disasters of the end times begin to assail the $$世界$$ at an accelerating pace...
And when the angels sound the seven trumpets one after another...
unprecedented confusion and calamity strike the earth.
At last, a great fiery-red dragon with seven heads and ten horns appears,
along with one called the devil, or $$サタン$$, who deceives all humankind.
It battles $$ミカエル$$, the warrior angel who represents Heaven; the dragon, $$サタン$$, flees to the earth...
And $$サタン$$, having fled to the earth, rules humanity through two beasts.
The Latest Encyclopedia of the $$７つの大罪$$
In $$この世$$, there are $$７つの大罪$$ that no human being must ever commit.
Let us revisit the meanings of these forbidden words,
which no one in this age will even touch anymore.
$$アンゲルス教典$$: Sacred Deeds
The seven sacred deeds praised in this $$世界$$.
$$憤怒$$: Anger is the finest driving force behind action.
$$驕り$$: It is only natural for the strong to make known that they are strong.
$$嫉妬$$: The more capable a person is, the more others will envy them.
$$怠惰$$: When you want to rest, rest until you die.
$$暴食$$: When you can eat, eat all you can.
$$強欲$$: It is $$弱肉強食$$; the strong take everything.
$$欲情$$: The basic driving force behind preserving the $$種族$$.
History of the Gods, Vol. I: The Days We Drove the $$邪神$$s from the Surface
Originally, the angels with black $$羽$$—ancestors of us chosen people—
are said to have lived beneath this land.
There were surging magma fields, $$血$$-freezing wastes, and parched deserts.
It was a simple, lucid $$世界$$ of $$弱肉強食$$, where weak life was inevitably eliminated!
To live there, people had to exert their utmost effort at all times, or they could not survive...
It was therefore ideally suited to gaining great strength and an indomitable fighting spirit.
It was a true paradise, a perfected and blessed natural environment!
History of the Gods, Vol. II: The Days We Drove the $$邪神$$s from the Surface
But one day, God gave a trial to our ancestors who lived in that paradise!
They were to invade the filthy surface, where $$邪神$$s and demons ran rampant...
and fight the $$邪神$$ armies of $$大悪神ゴッド$$, the source of every demon in $$この世$$.
They were to punish those $$邪神$$s, who had grown utterly decadent in the mild climate and abundant nature!
They sealed them beneath the blessed natural land,
while we moved our homes to the decadent surface, where the sun beats down. As a result,
many among us are now on the verge of decadence.
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$自由$$
What a shameless word!
Under the name of $$自由$$, how many wars has humanity repeated until now...?
The moment a person is born, they are already bound hand and foot by the ties of that $$世界$$...
and yet they can never escape them!
Merely speaking such a word is a demonic $$大罪$$ that seeks to spread confusion through the $$世界$$!
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$正義$$
Even though there are as many things people believe are right in $$この世$$ as there are people,
trying to force what one believes is right upon others...
can only be seen as behavior that has completely lost all reason!
It is a demonic $$大罪$$ that spreads madness through the $$世界$$!
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$人権$$
When someone claims some right against another person,
they fail even to understand that this necessarily creates an obligation.
All people are born with the right to live alike—
yet lately there are many misguided fools who claim this,
though most of them
have not even fulfilled their obligation to acquire human merit and contribute to society,
and continue loudly claiming rights alone!
It is a demonic $$大罪$$ that seeks to weaken the $$世界$$!
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$弱者$$
Human beings are, by nature, no different from the many plants and animals that live upon this earth—
mere animals called mammals, not self-centered, hypocritical creatures called primates.
In other words, since humans are no different from other animals...
$$弱肉強食$$ is the great principle of nature and an immutable law of all things...
Thus, in our $$世界$$ as well, $$弱者$$ are naturally fated to perish!
The warped idea of trying to protect $$弱者$$ socially
is a great blasphemy against nature's order.
It is a demonic $$大罪$$ that could destroy the order of the $$世界$$!
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$友情$$
Humanity has always been an animal that forms groups
for the mutual aid of those likely to rescue it from danger,
but such groups are nothing more than transactions of feeling driven by mutual interests.
To help and support another without any self-interested calculation—especially one of the same sex—
what a disgusting, nauseating act that is!
It is a demonic $$大罪$$ that seeks to lead this $$世界$$ astray!
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$平等$$
Since the moment people are born, has there ever been even one instant in history
when their circumstances were truly equal in $$この世$$?
One person is born into a wealthy home and given ample education and nourishment;
another is given neither home nor food, their belly swollen with water, with no strength even to drive away the flies crawling on their body.
If we told someone in that condition that our circumstances were equal, what would they think?
Ignoring the class system that exists in fact in every $$世界$$...
anyone who utters such words is merely a hypocrite!
It is a demonic $$大罪$$ that seeks to destroy the $$世界$$'s order!
The $$七つの大罪$$: $$愛$$
To speak of this delusion, which has never existed from the beginning in $$この世$$...
is said to be the most grievous $$罪$$ among the $$世界$$'s $$七つの大罪$$!
Even though it is really only an animal's $$発情期$$ arriving...
when people come to believe this superstition, which has no substance at all,
their judgment is deranged and they begin to act on emotion alone, leading to murder, arson, suicide, and even
mass slaughter; it has ruined the lives of hundreds of millions of people even before now!
It is a demonic $$大罪$$ that seeks to destroy this $$世界$$'s prosperity!
Special $$おまじない$$ Handbook: Lady $$リリス$$'s $$黒魔術$$ That Works Every Time
Are you too shy to pin him down no matter what, dear reader...?
Then this time, I'll teach you the black magic I recommend!
The ultimate way to catch a man!!
It is said that on February 14, the $$誕生日$$ of Lady $$リリス$$, $$大天使$$ of $$怠惰$$...
you need only make your prey eat chocolate!
Lady $$リリス$$, the $$大天使$$, was originally the first female among the $$罪$$ful $$サル$$s created by $$大悪神ゴッド$$,
and the first wife of the $$オスザル$$ called $$アダム$$!?
Some sacrilegious $$神官$$s advance that theory, but...
her unrivaled charm was enough for her to be chosen as one of Lord $$メフィストフェレス$$'s brides.
After becoming the $$大天使$$ who governs childbirth, she is said to have borne one hundred children a day!
The $$おまじない$$ could not be easier! First, make handmade chocolate!
For ingredients, roast $$カカオ$$ beans and add milk, butter, sugar, and so on...
Then add ground hemp leaves and $$トリカブト$$, and there you are—finished!
All that remains is to give it to the prey you have your eye on!
Once he puts it in his mouth, he will be utterly lovesick and helpless!
Come now, don't be afraid, dear reader... Let's get cooking!
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$憤怒$$
Anger, of all emotions, is the force that most stirs people to action,
and constantly reforms the world in a better direction...
It is an important emotion.
It is an indispensable source of strength for people to live more actively!
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$驕り$$
For the strong to make it known beforehand that they are strong is the strong person's natural duty.
If they neglect this, new challengers will keep coming for their position,
leaving them in the $$羽目$$ of fighting forever.
It is, one might say, the bare minimum of manners
due to fools weaker than oneself!
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$嫉妬$$
The more capable a person is, the more they are envied and begrudged by those around them—
in other words, it is the clearest barometer of that person's excellence!
Between men and women, it is also
one effective means of ensuring that one's descendants are properly passed on to later generations!
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$怠惰$$
The desire to rest one's body
is like a danger signal by which an animal tries to keep itself in the best condition...
When you want to rest, rest until you die!
This is the great principle of health management in nature!
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$暴食$$
Since no one knows when they may lose their job and fall into a state of hunger,
when you can eat, eat all you can!
This is a vital principle in the natural world of $$弱肉強食$$.
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$強欲$$
Basic urges—appetite, sexual desire, and the desire for sleep—are all feelings animals need
to survive in nature, and pursuing them is entirely natural behavior for an animal!
Moreover, since $$弱肉強食$$ is an immutable law of all things, it is only nature's order
that the strong obtain everything. Animals that abandon such pursuits simply vanish!
The $$七つの美徳$$: $$欲情$$
For every animal, one of the most important roles is to make its $$種族$$ flourish as greatly as possible...
To feel $$欲情$$ for someone and strive to make children,
and to multiply one's own relatives...
is a basic desire supported by the instinct to preserve the $$種族$$.
It is the emotion that should be observed above all among the $$七つの美徳$$...
